messages:
ci-bot: [CI] audit-schema-checks failed on main · job=audit-validator · https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 :warning:

alex_cheng: heads up — audit event validation is failing in CI. failing test: event_signature_check. Log snippet attached below, looks like signature canonicalization mismatch for KMS metadata.

alex_cheng: ```
I2026-03-19T22:01:12Z validator.go:134 verifySignature failed: computed_sig=QmFzZTY0X3ZhbA== expected_sig=QmFzZTY0X2V4cA==
context: kms_key_id=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck-1 actor.id=svc-user-123 actor.email= <MISSING>
```

marina: ack. assigning to triage. I'll pull the job logs and try a local repro. :eyes:

samir: fyi we had an RBAC shim change last week that normalized actor fields during sync. @jordan_tolley did you land that?

jordan_tolley: I did a tiny shim to drop empty actor.email fields coming from legacy keystore. I thought it was harmless but maybe it changed canonicalization. pinging to roll back if needed.

alex_cheng: yep — validator's canonical string is currently: "actor.id|actor.email|event_type|kms_key_id|payload_hash". If actor.email is absent we stringify as empty token which changes the signed payload. Some golden fixtures assumed email present; CI compares signature bytes.

rachel_s: customer-facing audit exports will break if signatures differ. We need to be conservative. Options:
- revert shim so actor.email is an explicit empty string (keeps canonicalization stable)
- change canonicalization to use actor.id fallback when email missing (compat risk)
- regenerate golden signatures (only if we accept new canonicalization)

marina: repro steps I used locally:
```bash
# run validator locally against sample event
./scripts/run-audit-validator --event samples/unsigned-actor.json --kms-sim 
```
sample failing event (minimal):
```json
{
  "event_type": "role.assign",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-user-123" },
  "kms_key_id": "projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck-1",
  "signature": "QmFzZTY0X2V4cA==",
  "payload_hash": "sha256:abcd..."
}
```
Note actor.email is missing. Validator computes different signature.

samir: quick triage note — the keystore shim was meant to normalize by removing empty string fields, not preserve them. That collided with the signing code which expects stable placeholder. My bad.

alex_cheng: plan proposal:
1) Revert the shim in staging to restore previous behavior (explicit empty string).
2) Add unit test in validator for canonicalization when actor.email missing.
3) Add a migration doc + small script to regenerate golden signatures for customers if we choose to change canonicalization in future.
4) Open PR with revert + tests, run CI.

jordan_tolley: I can revert the shim now in staging and cut a small patch.

kubebot: @jordan_tolley started a deployment to staging (deploy/stage-123) :rocket:

ci-bot: rerun triggered by marina · job=audio-schema-checks · build=12346

ci-bot: [CI] build=12346 still failing · audit-validator · event_signature_check :x:

marina: still failing on build; looks like revert didn't hit the worker image cache. @samir can you run the validator binary directly in the staging container and confirm file contents?

samir: digging in. found the shim revert but the canonicalization library was vendored in a different package — missed in staging bump. pushing a tiny patch that undefines the normalization helper.

alex_cheng: once tests pass we'll need a changelog entry and to notify Dedicated customers (they mirror audit exports). Mark customer-impact: low but visible.

rachel_s: agree. I'll draft a short customer note and coordinate with account teams after the patch lands.

marina: opening PR now with revert + unit test + CI fix. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/6789 (WIP)

samir: running end-to-end keystore sim now, ETA ~2h. If green I'll merge and trigger release candidate.

alex_cheng: nice. Also add a goldenset diff run: `make goldens-update CHECK=event_signature` so we can verify no other events regress.

marina: added checklist in PR description. tagging @rachel_s for customer comms, @samir for keystore sim, @jordan_tolley to watch deploy.

kubebot: CI build=12347 succeeded on PR 6789 :white_check_mark:

alex_cheng: merging after approvals. After merge we should run a one-off job to revalidate historical goldenset and upload artifact for SRE rollback.

rachel_s: will prepare the customer note draft, target send window after patch release window.

marina: closing loop — thanks everyone. followup: add explicit test cases for missing actor.email in validator test matrix (unit + e2e).
